claims.evidence: Seller later states 'Tokunbo, direct from Belgium' in the same message - two incompatible origin stories for one part.
Contradicts the earlier 'Direct America' claim in the same text; report shows no import documentation or markings confirming origin.
Photo shows visible dirt, oil residue, surface rust/staining, and disconnected hanging wiring on the intake side - not a clean or ready-to-test presentation.
No written warranty document, receipt, or shop stamp visible in the photo.
No start-up video, compression test, or sound clip provided; photo is static and shows disconnected wiring, inconsistent with a running/tested state.
No odometer, hour-meter, or paperwork visible; mileage cannot be read from an external engine photo.
Valve cover and timing area are not shown close-up; no seal, bolt-torque marks, or gasket condition visible to confirm it was never opened.

risks.risk: Conflicting origin claims (America vs Belgium) suggest a copy-pasted or fabricated listing.
risks.proof: Seller must state one consistent origin and provide an import/customs document or shipping label photo.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified-origin used engine, no premium for 'tokunbo' or 'direct import' status

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (knock, worn bearings, timing issues) despite 'tested' claim.
risks.proof: A start-up video with audible idle and no smoke, plus a compression test reading.

risks.risk: Exact engine code/displacement unknown, affecting compatibility and value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp/plate (usually on block near the bell-housing) or VIN-matching paperwork.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic VVT-i unit, no model-specific premium

risks.risk: Missing accessories (ECU, harness, sensors) reduce usability; intake wiring already shown disconnected.
risks.proof: Full photo set showing ECU, complete wiring harness, and sensor count matching a standard kit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete/bare engine, deduct for missing harness/ECU

risks.risk: Possible flood, fire, or accident history not visible externally.
risks.proof: Photos of oil pan underside, water marks inside intake, and a borescope look into a cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-history used engine, worst case assumed

risks.risk: No proof of the claimed 3-month guarantee being honorable or genuine.
risks.proof: Written guarantee slip or shop name/contact that can be verified independently.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sold as-is, no warranty value added

proof_requests: Clarify and prove actual country of origin with shipping/import documents
Close-up photo of engine code/displacement stamp
Start-up video with audible sound, no smoke, and a compression test reading
Full photo set of all sides, oil pan, and intake area with harness/ECU shown
response.reason: The seller's own words contain two mutually exclusive origin stories (America and Belgium) alongside unverifiable 'tested/no-knock/never-opened' claims that contradict the photo's dirty, disassembled appearance, a pattern typical of templated scam listings.
